item.title: BRITISH CHAMPION: Taekwon-do student from Chorleywood wins gold medal
item.description: A young Taekwon-do student from Chorleywood has been crowned the British champion after triumphing in a recent competition. item.title: GOLDEN QUEST: Radlett community invited to take part in a festive hunt to find gold coins
item.description: Radlett residents were invited to a taste of treasure in December as Phillies Café in Radlett hid twelve gold coins around the village, mainly in and around the High Street. item.description: Year 3 pupils from Christ Church Chorleywood enjoyed an exciting, hands-on exploration of Rocks and Soil during a special visit to Woodoaks Farm in Maple Cross last month.
